before_observation.scope: The prior checksum-verified archive binary was run against the new fixture. The harness exited at the first new assertion, so no prior-binary result for connection-upgrade-200 is claimed.

fixture: Disposable Linux network namespace with no external route; synthetic HTTP/1.1 200 responses with ordinary text body and either Upgrade: websocket alone or Connection: keep-alive, UpGrAdE alone. Existing 101 control retained.
limitations: After-fix local test used a debug binary built from the uncommitted working tree; PR and exact merged-main CI must independently validate the committed source.
The controlled fixture exercises two HTTP 200 header shapes and an existing 101 case, not all malformed protocol states, intermediaries, HTTP/2, native clients or a final owner-approved candidate.
No packet-wide absence claim is made from the added response-header cases; the fixture has no external route. Traffic sent via other tools is outside Outbound Guard.
Independent human review was not obtained for this milestone (optional for Outbound Guard).
